'''Pol Arias Dourdet''' (born 8 August 1996) is an Andorran [[Swimming (sport)|swimmer]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.olympicchannel.com/en/athletes/detail/pol-arias-dourdet/|title=Pol ARIAS DOURDET|website=Olympic Channel|access-date=2 March 2020|archive-date=2 March 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200302043449/https://www.olympicchannel.com/en/athletes/detail/pol-arias-dourdet/|url-status=live}}</ref> He competed in the [[Swimming at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's 400 metre freestyle|men's 400 metre freestyle]] event at the [[2016 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="Bio">{{cite web|url=https://www.rio2016.com/en/athlete/pol-arias-dourdet |title=Pol Arias Dourdet |accessdate=7 August 2016 |work=Rio 2016 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160806061635/https://www.rio2016.com/en/athlete/pol-arias-dourdet |archive-date=6 August 2016}}</ref>
